messages:
sam: Heads-up — EIR customer asked for proof of key escrow access patterns and forensics capabilities. Specifically: list of KMS key access events, who accessed wrapped keys, and ability to prove no plaintext exposure. Anyone have the canonical answer we give for Private deployments? Link to questionnaire: https://acme.example.com/sec-questionnaire

maya: For Private we collect KMS audit logs via our log-forwarder to customer's SIEM. We can provide HSM/KMS request IDs, principal, action, and ciphertext object IDs. Not sure about wrapped key access proof.

alex: We don't store plaintext. For AWS KMS the relevant CloudTrail events are GenerateDataKey, Decrypt, ReEncrypt. We can map those to our internal tenant_id and request_id.

lucy: Should confirm retention window — the customer wants 3 years. Current default is 365 days in long-term storage for enterprise tier.

sam: Right. Can we show a sample export format? customer wants CSV with columns: timestamp, principal, action, key_id, request_id, model_request_id.

maya: I can draft a sanitized export. Example log line:

```
{"timestamp":"2025-09-01T15:02:11Z","principal":"svc-redwood-inference-ded-01","action":"Decrypt","key_id":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd...","request_id":"req_7f9c","tenant_id":"acme-corp","model_request_id":"r_890"}
```

alex: Also flag that for HSMs we have attestation reports; for on-prem we can provide key custody matrix and dual-control procedures.

security-bot: note: SOC2 evidence bucket updated: s3://redwood-evidence/escrow-exports/ (access: eng-security, se-team). :white_check_mark:

sam: For the questionnaire we'll propose: (1) retention configurable to customer policies; (2) exportable audit CSV + raw CloudTrail/KMS logs; (3) attestation for HSMs; (4) RBAC — only key-managers role can perform key material export flows and those actions are logged.

maya: I'll prep the Q&A entry and sample export. Can someone add the forensics playbook note about live memory? I want to avoid promising memory sweeps.

alex: Added note: we do NOT perform memory forensics across customer workloads. We can offer guidance for customers to run forensics in their private environment or we can run assisted forensics under contract and with explicit scope.

sam: Great. Action items: maya draft response by EOD, alex attach list of CloudTrail events and mapping, lucy confirm retention SLA change feasibility with infra. tagging @lucy @alex @maya

lucy: Ack, will check retention changes and update by tomorrow.

maya: On it. Will post draft here when ready. :thumbsup:
